query: My Nexa X1 screen inputs are delayed and the touch responsiveness is laggy, causing a noticeable delay when I try to interact with the phone.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touchscreen Issues Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Touchscreen issues fix

actions.description: It will turn on touch sensitivity

steps: If you wish to keep your screen protector on, try enabling the "Touch sensitivity" option.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Display.
Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity.

actions.description: It will let you adjust navigation bar

steps: To prevent this, disable the full screen gesture function.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Display.
Tap on Navigation bar.
Select Buttons to turn off full screen gestures.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open navigation bar settings under Display
actionableDeeplink.message: Choose navigation type in Display settings

actions.description: It will turn off touch sensitivity

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Display.
Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.

actions.description: It will rule out touch interference

steps: If your screen protector is peeling or has debris under it, remove it.

actions.description: It will remove dust and moisture

steps: To clean your device, gently wipe the front and back with a lint-free, soft microfiber cloth or a camera lens cleaning cloth.
Avoid applying too much pressure when cleaning.

actions.description: It will rule out faulty charging accessories

steps: If you suspect this is the case, try using a different, undamaged charger.
Avoid using the touchscreen while your device is charging.

actions.description: It will arrange expert help and service

steps: If the issue persists after trying all these steps, reach out to Customer Support for further assistance.

actions.description: It will refresh the phone system

steps: For devices with a Power button: Press and hold the Power button.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.
For devices with a Side button: Swipe down from the top of the screen with two fingers to open the Quick settings panel.
Tap the Power icon.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.
If the touchscreen is completely unresponsive, force a restart by pressing and holding the Volume down button and the Power button (or Side button) simultaneously for about 10 seconds.
Once the device turns off, press the Power button or Side button again to turn it back on.

actions.description: It will install the latest software

steps: Check for updates for any third-party apps you use, as these can sometimes affect gesture customization.

actions.description: It will check for problem apps

steps: Press and hold the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button at the same time.
Alternatively, swipe down from the top of the screen with two fingers.
Tap the Power icon.
Touch and hold Power off.
Tap Safe mode.
Once in Safe mode, try removing any third-party apps that were recently updated or installed around the time the issue began.
To exit Safe mode, restart your phone or tablet, and it will boot up normally.

actions.description: It will restore factory default settings

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on General management.
Tap on Reset.
Tap on Factory data reset.
Swipe to and tap Reset.
Tap Delete all.
Enter your TechCorp account credentials to complete the reset.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open factory data reset settings under Reset
actionableDeeplink.message: Go to factory data reset in Reset
